records.jp: （そっか……）
records.en_original: (I see...)
records.en: (I see...)

records.jp: （…………私、勘違いしてた）
records.en_original: (...I've had it all wrong.)
records.en: (...I've had it all wrong.)

records.jp: （弱音を吐いちゃいけない、<CR>誰にも頼らず、一番前を歩かないといけない――）
records.en_original: (I always thought that leaders had to stand alone.)
records.en: (I always thought that leaders had to stand alone.)

records.jp: （リーダーって、そういう存在だと思ってた）
records.en_original: (That they had to forge a new path themselves, never relying on others, never looking behind.)
records.en: (That they had to forge a new path themselves, never relying on others, never looking behind.)

records.jp: でも、違ったんだ
records.en_original: But I was wrong.
records.en: But I was wrong.

records.jp: そういうふうに突き進める人も<CR>いるかもしれないけど……私は、そうじゃない
records.en_original: Maybe some people can handle doing all that, but...I'm not one of them.
records.en: Maybe some people can handle doing all that, but...I'm not one of them.

records.jp: 私はやっぱり、特別な人間にはなれなかった。<CR>けど……相談してみて分かった
records.en_original: I'm not a special person. But one thing is clearer to me now more than ever—
records.en: I'm not a special person. But one thing is clearer to me now more than ever—

records.jp: ――私はこのチームが好きだ。<CR>この世界で出会ったみんなのことが好きだ
records.en_original: I love this team. I love everyone that I've met here in this world.
records.en: I love this team. I love everyone that I've met here in this world.

records.jp: だから……みんなとのつながりを失いたくない。<CR>私は、私にできることをしたい……！！
records.en_original: I don't want to lose all the precious bonds we made! That's why I'll do whatever I can!
records.en: I don't want to lose all the precious bonds we made! That's why I'll do whatever I can!

records.jp: （……みんなに伝えに行こう。<CR>私の想い、これからの決意を……！）
records.en_original: (I've made up my mind. I have to tell the others about how I feel!)
records.en: (I've made up my mind. I have to tell the others about how I feel!)

records.jp: 愛央ちゃん、話って……？
records.en_original: Ao, you wanted to tell us something...?
records.en: Ao, you wanted to tell us something...?

records.jp: ごめん！！
records.en_original: I'm sorry!
records.en: I'm sorry!

records.jp: 私のせいで大変なことになっちゃったのと……
records.en_original: It's my fault that we're in this mess.
records.en: It's my fault that we're in this mess.

records.jp: それと……しょぼくれてたこと
records.en_original: And...I let myself get down in the dumps about it.
records.en: And...I let myself get down in the dumps about it.

records.jp: それを言うなら……わたしたちこそ、ごめんだよ
records.en_original: Well... I think we owe you an apology too.
records.en: Well... I think we owe you an apology too.

records.en_original: You do...?
records.en: You do...?

records.jp: うん。私たちも、リーダーだからって<CR>愛央に任せきりになっちゃってたと思う
records.en_original: Yeah. We let you take all of the responsibility as leader.
records.en: Yeah. We let you take all of the responsibility as leader.

records.jp: もしあの時、愛央ちゃんが声をかけてくれなかったら<CR>倒せなかったかもしれないよね
records.en_original: If Ao hadn't been there, we may have never beaten that thing in the first place.
records.en: If Ao hadn't been there, we may have never beaten that thing in the first place.

records.jp: はい。大きなクラックが起きて……<CR>わたし含め、みんな動揺してたと思います
records.en_original: Agreed. We were all so panicked about the Crack, we couldn't do anything.
records.en: Agreed. We were all so panicked about the Crack, we couldn't do anything.

records.jp: でも愛央だけが……<CR>あの時、あの状況で、それでも未来のことを考えた
records.en_original: You were the only one of us who had her head on straight then.
records.en: You were the only one of us who had her head on straight then.

records.jp: いち早く愛央が前を向いたからこそ、<CR>私たちはこうして今も生きていられるのよ
records.en_original: It's thanks to your ability to face the future that we're alive at all.
records.en: It's thanks to your ability to face the future that we're alive at all.

records.jp: みんな……
records.en_original: You guys...
records.en: You guys...

records.jp: じゃあ、お互い「ごめん」だね
records.en_original: I guess we all have something we feel bad about, huh.
records.en: I guess we all have something we feel bad about, huh.

records.jp: うん。そして……<CR>これからはきっと、変わっていける
records.en_original: Yes. And now we can find a way to fix this together.
records.en: Yes. And now we can find a way to fix this together.

records.jp: 幸いなことに、私たちはまだ生きている
records.en_original: The most important thing is that we are all still here.
records.en: The most important thing is that we are all still here.

records.jp: 生きていれば、どんな可能性もゼロじゃない。<CR>やれることは絶対にまだある
records.en_original: As long as we live, there's always a chance. We aren't out of options yet.
records.en: As long as we live, there's always a chance. We aren't out of options yet.

records.jp: そうだよ！　ここまでみんなでやってきたんだから。<CR>なんとかなる、私はそう信じてる
records.en_original: Exactly! We've gotten this far together. We'll figure it out, one way or another.
records.en: Exactly! We've gotten this far together. We'll figure it out, one way or another.

records.jp: 私もまだまだ元気有り余ってるし！<CR>またあのデカブツ出てきたら倒せばいいよ！
records.en_original: I'm not giving up yet! If another big demon shows up, all we gotta do is beat 'em!
records.en: I'm not giving up yet! If another big demon shows up, all we gotta do is beat 'em!

records.jp: 不安があるなら言って。みんなで考えましょう？
records.en_original: If you ever have a problem, tell us. We'll solve it together.
records.en: If you ever have a problem, tell us. We'll solve it together.

records.jp: うん……！
records.en_original: Yeah...!
records.en: Yeah...!

records.jp: ようやく愛央らしい愛央が戻ってきたな
records.en_original: That's the Ao we all know and love.
records.en: That's the Ao we all know and love.

records.jp: あーーーー！！
records.en_original: Aaaaahhh!!!
records.en: Aaaaahhh!!!

records.en_original: Phew...
records.en: Phew...

records.jp: 今までの人生で、こんなに感謝されたこと、ないよ
records.en_original: I don't know if I've ever felt so loved.
records.en: I don't know if I've ever felt so loved.

records.jp: なんにもないって、ずっと思ってたから……
records.en_original: I used to think that I had nothing...
records.en: I used to think that I had nothing...

records.jp: でも、今は違う…………
records.en_original: But things couldn't be more different now.
records.en: But things couldn't be more different now.

records.jp: こんなにたくさん……私には、もったいないよ
records.en_original: I have so much, I almost feel like I don't deserve it.
records.en: I have so much, I almost feel like I don't deserve it.

records.jp: （……私、幸せ者だ。<CR>こんな友達に出会えて、本当に良かった……）
records.en_original: (I'm so lucky to have such great friends...)
records.en: (I'm so lucky to have such great friends...)

records.jp: （私は特別じゃない。でも、みんなとの<CR>この“つながり”だけは、代えられない特別だ！）
records.en_original: (I'm not special. But what IS special are the bonds that we made together!)
records.en: (I'm not special. But what IS special are the bonds that we made together!)

records.jp: 私、この絆は絶対に失いたくない。<CR>だから……みんなで守ろう、私たちの世界を
records.en_original: I don't want to lose what we have here. Let's protect this world together!
records.en: I don't want to lose what we have here. Let's protect this world together!

records.jp: 私たちなら――できないことなんて、何もない！
records.en_original: As long as we're together, there's nothing we can't do!
records.en: As long as we're together, there's nothing we can't do!
